race.comment: LUCONI (1) fought on for third last start over 1666m at Ipswich, making it two minor placings in a row. Backmarker who gets home hard. Beautifully placed against this line-up and is sure to prove tough to beat. STANDLEE (5) is coming off a determined win last start over 1400m at Beaudesert three weeks ago. Gets some weight relief this time so he is among the leading chances again. PRIVALOVA (8) turned things around last start and landed the prize by a nose after being prominent at the bend as favourite over 1500m at Kilcoy. Likely to be right there at the finish again. HEAVENLY LOVE (2) finished third last time over 1300m at Toowoomba, beaten only 0.9 lengths. Expect a big run despite the sticky draw.
